summary: Search interest keeps clustering in K-beauty and 'clean' skincare actives (PDRN, kojic acid, hypochlorous acid, nano-hydroxyapatite, under-eye patches), small-space home goods, and Google's Holiday 100 gift items (lymphatic face brush +400%, toy train sets +240%, adjustable roller skates +180%). China-origin duty is now MFN + legacy Section 301 (25% on Lists 1-3, 7.5% on List 4A) + a 12.5% Section 301 forced-labor tariff that began July 24, 2026; IEEPA tariffs ended Feb 24, 2026 and the Section 122 surcharge expired July 24. The 178 Section 301 exclusions were due to expire Nov 9, 2026 with no extension found.
changes_vs_last_run: The three prior leaders (HOCl spray, nHA toothpaste, peptide eye cream) were kept and re-checked against fresh supplier listings; cost inputs are unchanged because no better quotes surfaced. New entrants: hydrogel under-eye patches, lymphatic face brush kit, PDRN serum, kojic acid serum, batana hair mask, beef tallow balm, toe spacers, creatine gummies, adjustable kids roller skates, wooden train set, scent booster beads, hair wax stick, brow lamination kit, 4-pack magnetic spice rack, dog stroller. Dropped without re-research this week: cordless vacuum, cat litter box, neck massager, mini projector, water filter, padel set, collagen powder (no supplier quote or second source found). Electronics and home items carried over from 2026-11-09 were NOT re-verified; their inputs are last week's. Score moves cannot be stated because the scoring script runs after this file. Two new kills added.

candidates.name: Hypochlorous acid face and body spray 2-pack, 3.4 oz
candidates.angle: Opaque, stable bottle with a dated expiry and cosmetic-only positioning against Briotech and Ulta brands.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling). Avoid 'treats acne/eczema' (drug) and 'disinfects/kills germs' (likely EPA FIFRA pesticide claims). Amazon beauty may require documents.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 148,400 searches/mo, +8,900% over 5 years. Pravada US private label: MOQ 50-250 units, sample $8.45, no per-unit price published. Marketplace China listings $0.65-1.06/unit (unverified). I assumed $3/unit US contract-filled (2-pack = $6) and 0% duty because it is US-filled; imported components are not counted. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess (unit lasts ~2 months). Competition and complaint scores are judgment, not measured review counts.

candidates.name: Fluoride-free nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste, 3-pack of 3.4 oz tubes
candidates.angle: Smooth 10% nHA formula in a 3-pack with a refill option, positioned against Boka and Apagard.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Fluoride-free toothpaste is generally a cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration, product listing, ingredient labeling. Do not claim to prevent cavities or remineralize enamel (drug claims). Fluoride versions are OTC drugs.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 43,300 searches/mo, +6,200% over 5 years. Chinese listings $0.19-0.80/tube at MOQ 20-10,000 (bare product, no tube/box/landed cost). Cinoll says it treats fluoride-free toothpaste as a MoCRA cosmetic (supplier claim). I used $2.50/tube boxed. Duty = assumed 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%; HTS list status not confirmed. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess.

candidates.name: Peptide eye cream, 0.5 oz, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Airless pump, fragrance-free formula, 2-pack sized for about three months.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA: facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling. No claims to repair collagen or treat wrinkles (drug claims). Expect Amazon beauty gating.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 6,600/mo, +325%. Carried from 2026-11-09; private-label quotes conflict ($2.40-4.80 vs $4-22 per jar). I used $6/jar for a US contract-made, boxed jar; 0% duty assumes US fill. Heavily competed by established brands.

candidates.name: Hydrogel under-eye patches, 2 jars of 60 pairs
candidates.angle: Tighter-fitting patch shape with a resealable liner jar and a fragrance-free formula.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (registration, listing, safety substantiation). No claims about removing dark circles permanently or treating under-eye conditions. Amazon beauty may require ingredient documents.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 76,400/mo, +455% over 5 years. Beautetrade FOB $0.08-0.15/pair at MOQ 500 pairs (bare patches); Alibaba collagen hydrogel $0.25/pair at 1,000 with branding needing 3,000 MOQ. I assumed $0.12/pair x 60 + jar/label/box = about $9 per jar, so $18 for two. Duty assumed List 4A 7.5% + 12.5%, unconfirmed for 3304. Heavy competition; scores are judgment.

candidates.name: PDRN peptide face serum, 30 ml, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Lightweight non-sticky PDRN serum in an airless pump with a visible concentration percentage.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA. Salmon-derived PDRN needs a raw-material safety file; no 'regenerates skin' or 'repairs DNA' drug claims. Amazon beauty gating possible.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 42,400/mo, +6,000% over 5 years. Xiran lists many PDRN serums but only as 'instant quote'; MOQ ~1,000 for standard bottles. No public price for PDRN. I borrowed RainShadow's $8-15 per 30 ml for brightening serums and used $8/unit for a US-made serum. Low-medium confidence on cost. 0% duty assumes US fill; a China fill would be about 20%.

candidates.name: Kojic acid + niacinamide dark-spot serum, 1 oz, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Gentler stabilized kojic formula in an airless pump with a patch-test guide.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA. 'Lightens/fades dark spots' is a borderline drug claim; keep to 'brightening' and avoid skin-bleaching language. Kojic acid is restricted in some markets, but not in the US.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 55,400/mo, +1,233% over 5 years. RainShadow wholesale brightening serums $8-15 per 30 ml; Wholesale Natural Body Care $17/1 oz; Etsy retail $25-45. I used $10/unit, so $20 for the 2-pack. Margin is thin at this price. 0% duty assumes US-made.

candidates.name: Lymphatic sculpting face brush + gua sha kit
candidates.angle: Gift-boxed brush, stainless gua sha and illustrated routine card to beat $7 white-label brushes.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Manual massage tools are not regulated if no medical claims. Do not claim lymph drainage treats swelling or detoxifies. Standard FTC claim substantiation.
candidates.notes: Google Holiday 100: 'lymphatic sculpting face brush' searches +400%. Retail runs $6-7 (Walmart generics) to $32-78 (brands). I set price at $34.99, below the owner's $40 per-customer target on purpose; 1.2 orders/yr is a guess. Alibaba: gua sha $0.33-0.37 at MOQ 500; manual brush cost not found, assumed $2. Duty guess: Lists 1-3 style 25% + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Batana oil hair growth mask, 4 oz, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Fragrance-balanced, rinse-friendly mask with transparent batana sourcing, sold as a 2-pack.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA. 'Grows hair' or 'prevents loss' is a drug claim; use 'nourishes' and 'conditions'. Check sourcing documentation for Honduran batana oil.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: batana oil shampoo 10,500/mo, +6,700% over 5 years. Prices: $6.99-29.99 per unit on Amazon trackers; Walmart masks $8.99-12.99 with 4.7 stars on 571 reviews. ASINSight: 132 competing products and ~100 searches/week for 'batana hair mask' in June-July 2026, so demand may be narrower than ET suggests. Cost $3.50/unit is my guess, no quote. Price below $40 target; 1.8 orders gives about $54 per customer.

candidates.name: Whipped beef tallow face and body balm, 4 oz, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Grass-fed, lightly scented balm with a heat-stable formula and a clear sourcing story.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA; no drug claims for eczema. Animal-derived ingredient: label sourcing accurately and expect some Amazon beauty documentation requests.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: beef tallow soap 2,500/mo, +7,600% over 5 years (small base). Retail $15-28 per jar on Etsy/Walmart; Pravada MOQ 50; May's Naturals MSRP $18 for 9 oz. Cost $5/jar is my guess. Trend could be a fad (score 6).

candidates.name: Silicone toe spacers, 4-pair set with carry pouch
candidates.angle: Multi-size set with a fit chart so buyers find a pair that stays on.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Do not make bunion or medical claims; that could make it a Class I device. Keep to 'comfort' and 'toe alignment during rest'. Silicone: no special rule.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 36,300/mo, +279% over 5 years. Yiwu factory: about CN¥1.5-2.0 per pair at 100-1,000+; retail $5-8 per pair; Target 2 pair $12.19. Cost = 4 pairs at ~$0.25 + pouch. Price is far below the $40 target; this is a low-ticket item and is here because the economics are well sourced. Duty guess.

candidates.name: Creatine monohydrate gummies, 60 count (private label)
candidates.angle: Third-party-tested gummies with the full 5 g dose per serving and a clean sugar profile.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement: cGMP (21 CFR 111), FDA facility registration, Supplement Facts panel, no disease claims, adverse event reporting. Amazon requires supplement category approval and third-party test reports. Imported food-type goods need FDA prior notice.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 117,700/mo, +5,200% over 5 years. Alibaba listings show $1.50-5.00 per unit at MOQ ~100 boxes to 2,000 bottles; claims of FDA/NSF are seller assertions. Many gummies fail the dose claim (5 g does not fit in a gummy), which is also a lawsuit risk. Competition is dominated by big brands. Duty guess.

candidates.name: Bluetooth/USB 4x6 thermal shipping label printer (110mm), with starter label roll
candidates.angle: Reliable pairing, a one-page setup guide and bundled labels against Rollo, Munbyn and Nelko.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 for the radio module; UL/ETL for the power adapter; lithium battery needs UN38.3 if present.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics: 165,000/mo, +332%. Retail Nelko ~$70, Rollo ~$122. Alibaba ~$34-45 at 500+; I used $40. Duty = 25% + 12.5% conservative.

candidates.name: 15.6-inch 1080p USB-C portable monitor with magnetic cover stand
fixable_complaints: USB-C port lacks DisplayPort Alt Mode
candidates.angle: Include a compatibility checker, mini-HDMI cable, sturdier stand and brighter panel.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 declaration of conformity. No battery, so no lithium rules.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics: 6,600/mo, +838%. Alibaba $39-57 at 100 pieces; used $50. Retail price is a mid-market guess. Duty conservative.

candidates.name: 1L mini rice cooker with steam tray, non-stick pot
candidates.angle: 1.5L PFAS-free ceramic coating with bundled steamer for dorm and solo cooks.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL/ETL listing needed for Amazon electrical appliances; FDA food-contact compliance; PFAS-free claims must be substantiated.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics: 33,100/mo, +438%. Alibaba $8.80-19.59; used $15. HTS line unclear, so duty is conservative. Right at the $40 threshold.

candidates.name: Foldable ionic travel hair dryer with diffuser and storage pouch
candidates.angle: Dual-voltage 1600W motor with diffuser, bundled as a gift set.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL listing (UL 859/1727) and CPSC rules; no FCC needed for a plain heater.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics: 3,600/mo, +223% (small demand). Alibaba $6.65-9.00; used $9.50. MFN 3.9% + assumed 25% + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Magnetic fridge spice rack, 4-pack with side shelf
candidates.angle: Rubberized stronger magnets rated for a stated load, with sizes for jars and cans.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Strong magnets may limit air freight; otherwise none beyond standard rules. Metal contact surfaces: no food-contact rule if shelves are not food-contact.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics 'magnetic shelf' 6,600/mo, +983% (the term is ambiguous). Alibaba tiered: $7.40 at 500 sets for a 4-pack, $7.80 at 50-499. Walmart retail $8-25, 6-pack $20.69. Price below $40; Section 232 steel may replace the 12.5% for metal goods, so duty is a guess.

candidates.name: Japanese-style shiki floor futon mattress, twin, removable washable cover
fixable_complaints: too expensive for what it is
candidates.angle: Thicker, evenly filled mattress with a zipper cover and carry strap.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Mattress flammability 16 CFR 1632/1633; state law labels; bedding registration in some states (e.g., California, Pennsylvania).
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 22,200/mo, +479%. Walmart retail $50-140 for foldable floor futons, $70-120 shiki mattresses. No Alibaba quote found; unit cost $42 is my estimate. Duty is a guess (about 6% MFN + 7.5% + 12.5%). Bulky, so freight and fulfillment are rough.

candidates.name: Self-adhesive PET felt acoustic wall panels, 24-pack 12x12 in
candidates.angle: Designer colors, adhesive that works on painted walls, and a flame-rated certificate.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Fire-safety claims need ASTM E84 testing; California TB117/Prop 65 considerations; no other agency approval.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics: 135,000/mo, +191%. Alibaba listing prices are inconsistent; $16 per 24 is my conservative guess. Duty lowered to 0.375 to match a CBP ruling on Section 301 25%.

candidates.name: Non-electric dual-nozzle bidet attachment plus handheld travel bidet kit
candidates.angle: Brass fittings, a universal adapter kit and a leak-proof guarantee.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Plumbing: NSF/ANSI 61 or lead-free (Reduction of Lead in Drinking Water Act) for fittings; some retailers ask for CPC listing.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Alibaba $9.90-17.90 at 200 MOQ; I used $13 for a 2-item kit. Smart bidet 1,900/mo +750% (small base). Duty guess.

candidates.name: 20,000mAh 45W power bank with built-in USB-C cable and display
candidates.angle: Only win with verified true capacity and a replaceable cable; hard to beat Anker and Baseus.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UN38.3 test summary, FCC SDoC, UL 2056 or equivalent; ships as dangerous goods (Amazon DG review).
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Alibaba $9-11.50 at MOQ 500. Duty 3.4% MFN + 25% (Jan 2026 battery increase) + 12.5%. At the $40 floor; low confidence worth pursuing.

candidates.name: Car wash foam sprayer kit: 2L pump foamer, 2 microfiber mitts
candidates.angle: Brass nozzle and gasket with mitts so it reads as a complete kit.
candidates.regulatory_notes: No soap in the kit, to avoid state VOC/chemical rules; otherwise none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Carried from 2026-11-09, not re-verified. Exploding Topics 'foam sprayer' 49,500/mo, +176%. Alibaba 2L pumps $1.27-1.38 at MOQ 3,000 (too high). Seasonal. Low-medium confidence.

candidates.name: Foldable 4-wheel dog stroller, zipperless entry, up to 33 lb
candidates.angle: Sturdier wheels and a one-hand fold, with replacement-wheel spares in the box.
candidates.regulatory_notes: No federal approval; pet products have no CPSC rule, but Prop 65 labeling may apply. Weight-capacity claims should be load-tested.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 60,500/mo, +178%. Walmart BestPet 3-wheel at $49.99 (was $92.99) with ~29,000 reviews; Walmart range $30-100. Alibaba: large 3-wheel $58-60 at 100-659 units; another range £90-139 per unit. I assumed $45 for a cheaper 4-wheel at 300+ (no verified quote) and a high fulfillment fee. Price is a mid-market guess; the heavy incumbent BestPet is pulling prices down. Large item, so margin is thin.

candidates.name: Kids adjustable light-up quad roller skates, 4 sizes, with helmet and pads set
candidates.angle: Metal adjustment lock and sealed bearings, bundled with protective gear for gift buyers.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Children's product: CPSIA third-party testing at a CPSC-accepted lab, Children's Product Certificate, tracking label, lead and phthalate limits, ASTM F963 if marketed as a toy. Helmets need CPSC bicycle/skate standard compliance if included.
candidates.notes: Google Holiday 100: 'adjustable roller skates' +180%. Alibaba: 4 flashing wheel adjustable set $26.50 at 300-499 pairs, $25.38 at 500-2,999; cheaper listings $8.80-17 (unverified specs). Retail: SFR Hurricane IV $82.95. I added no cost for the protective gear, which will lower margin if included. Duty assumed conservative 25% + 12.5%; the 9506.70 list is unconfirmed. Seasonal (holiday).

candidates.name: Classic wooden toy train set, 100 pieces, with storage bin
fixable_complaints: pieces don't connect with big-brand track
candidates.angle: Track that mates with the major brand's rails, with a labeled storage bin and a tested paint finish.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Children's product: CPSIA third-party testing, Children's Product Certificate, ASTM F963 (small parts, magnets, paint lead), tracking label, age grading.
candidates.notes: Google Holiday 100: 'classic toy train set' +240%. Alibaba 100-piece sets: $40.50 (2-999 units), COMMIKI $23.96-25.09 at 100-999; eBay retail for a 100-piece set $68.58. Duty guess: 9503 MFN free + 7.5% + 12.5% (a 2026 vendor guide treats toys as List 4A; the Sept 2026 trade-deal toy relief is only a recommendation). Strong Q4 seasonality.

candidates.name: Laundry scent booster beads, 3-bag bundle (3 x 10 oz)
candidates.angle: Dye-free beads with a measured scoop and a sealed pouch.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Household product: CPSC child-resistant/hazard labeling review; fragrance ingredient disclosure rules in California and New York; Amazon hazmat review may apply.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: scent beads 7,000/mo, +467% over 5 years. Alibaba seller blog gives MOQ 500-1,000 for private label and 15-25% cost drops at higher MOQ but no bag price; a pod listing is $0.05/pc. Cost $2 per bag is my guess. Dominated by Downy/Gain, so competition is very low-scoring. Hazmat and duty are unverified.

candidates.name: Hair wax stick, 2.7 oz, 3-pack (coconut, strong hold)
candidates.angle: Non-flaking formula with a twist-up tube that survives hot cars, sold as a 3-pack.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (registration, listing, ingredient labeling); no hair-growth claims.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 40,500/mo, +589% over 5 years. Alibaba ready-to-ship private label stick $2.50 at 500+ ($2.90 at 1-99); other listing $0.90-3.50. Cost = 3 x $2.50. Price below $40; orders 2.0 gives about $54 per customer, a guess. Duty guess 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Brow lamination and styling gel kit with brush, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Flexible-hold gel with a spoolie and clear directions.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA. Avoid perming-style 'lamination' chemicals for home use unless they have a safety basis; hair-relaxer-style actives need label cautions. Eye-area products need extra safety substantiation.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: brow glue 6,600/mo, +227%. Alibaba: gel kit $2.30-2.73 at 200-999; lamination gel $1.20-1.80 at MOQ 500; kit $4.80-8.50. Cost $2.50 x 2 = $5. Price below $40; orders 1.8 gives about $54 per customer, a guess.

candidates.name: Dissolvable microneedle acne/blemish patches
candidates.kill_reason: FDA has not authorized any microneedling device for over-the-counter sale, so acne-treatment microneedle patches are unapproved devices.
candidates.angle: n/a
candidates.regulatory_notes: Hydrocolloid blemish patches without microneedles are sellable; microneedle versions carrying acne claims are devices.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 9,200/mo, +1,050%. Rejected on the FDA page; a plain hydrocolloid patch could be a separate candidate.

candidates.name: GLP-1 supplement
candidates.kill_reason: Products marketed as 'GLP-1' supplements imply drug effects that unapproved supplements cannot claim, and the name invites FDA and FTC action.
candidates.angle: n/a
candidates.regulatory_notes: Not legally sellable under that positioning; I did not verify a specific FDA warning this run.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 15,000/mo, 99x+ 5-year growth. Kill based on judgment about drug claims, not on a source I opened this run. Re-check before relying on it.
